tool.name: focus_app
tool.description: Focus Beeper Desktop and optionally navigate to a specific chat, message, or pre-fill draft text and attachment.

chatID.description: Optional Beeper chat ID (or local chat ID) to focus after opening the app. If omitted, only opens/focuses the app.

draftAttachmentPath.description: Optional draft attachment path to populate in the message input field.

draftText.description: Optional draft text to populate in the message input field.

messageID.description: Optional message ID. Jumps to that message in the chat when opening.

tool.name: search
tool.description: Search for chats, participant name matches in groups, and the first page of messages in one call. Use this when the user asks for a specific chat, group, or person.

query.description: User-typed search text. Literal word matching (NOT semantic).

tool.name: get_accounts
tool.description: List connected accounts on this device.

tool.name: get_chat
tool.description: Get chat details: metadata, participants (limited), last activity.

maxParticipantCount.description: Maximum number of participants to return. Use -1 for all; otherwise 0–500. Defaults to all (-1).

archived.description: True to archive, false to unarchive

tool.name: search_chats
tool.description: Search chats by title/network or participants using Beeper Desktop's renderer algorithm. Optional 'scope'.

accountIDs.description: Provide an array of account IDs to filter chats from specific messaging accounts only

items.description: Account ID this resource belongs to.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor; do not inspect. Use together with 'direction'.

direction.description: Pagination direction used with 'cursor': 'before' fetches older results, 'after' fetches newer results. Defaults to 'before' when only 'cursor' is provided.

inbox.description: Filter by inbox type: "primary" (non-archived, non-low-priority), "low-priority", or "archive". If not specified, shows all chats.

includeMuted.description: Include chats marked as Muted by the user, which are usually less important. Default: true. Set to false if the user wants a more refined search.

lastActivityAfter.description: Provide an ISO datetime string to only retrieve chats with last activity after this time

lastActivityBefore.description: Provide an ISO datetime string to only retrieve chats with last activity before this time

limit.description: Set the maximum number of chats to retrieve. Valid range: 1-200, default is 50

query.description: Literal token search (non-semantic). Use single words users type (e.g., "dinner"). When multiple words provided, ALL must match. Case-insensitive.

scope.description: Search scope: 'titles' matches title + network; 'participants' matches participant names.

type.description: Specify the type of chats to retrieve: use "single" for direct messages, "group" for group chats, or "any" to get all types

unreadOnly.description: Set to true to only retrieve chats that have unread messages

tool.name: set_chat_reminder
tool.description: Set a reminder for a chat at a specific time.

remindAtMs.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when reminder should trigger

dismissOnIncomingMessage.description: Cancel reminder if someone messages in the chat

tool.name: list_messages
tool.description: List messages from a specific chat with pagination support.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor; do not inspect. Use together with 'direction'.

direction.description: Pagination direction used with 'cursor': 'before' fetches older results, 'after' fetches newer results. Defaults to 'before' when only 'cursor' is provided.

tool.name: search_messages
tool.description:
Search messages across chats using Beeper's message index.
- When to use: find messages by text and/or filters (chatIDs, accountIDs, chatType, media type filters, sender, date ranges).
- CRITICAL: Query is LITERAL WORD MATCHING, NOT semantic search! Only finds messages containing these EXACT words.
  • ✅ RIGHT: query="dinner" or query="sick" or query="error" (single words users type)
  • ❌ WRONG: query="dinner plans tonight" or query="health issues" (phrases/concepts)
  • The query matches ALL words provided (in any order). Example: query="flight booking" finds messages with both "flight" AND "booking".
- Performance: provide chatIDs/accountIDs when known. Omitted 'query' returns results based on filters only. Partial matches enabled; 'excludeLowPriority' defaults to true.
- Workflow tip: To search messages in specific conversations: 1) Use find-chats to get chatIDs, 2) Use search-messages with those chatIDs.
- IMPORTANT: Chat names vary widely. ASK the user for clarification:
  • "Which chat do you mean by family?" (could be "The Smiths", "Mom Dad Kids", etc.)
  • "What's the name of your work chat?" (could be "Team", company name, project name)
  • "Who are the participants?" (use scope="participants" in search-chats)
Returns: matching messages and referenced chats.

accountIDs.description: Limit search to specific account IDs.

items.description: Account ID this resource belongs to.

chatIDs.description: Limit search to specific chat IDs.

chatType.description: Filter by chat type: 'group' for group chats, 'single' for 1:1 chats.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor; do not inspect. Use together with 'direction'.

dateAfter.description: Only include messages with timestamp strictly after this ISO 8601 datetime (e.g., '2024-07-01T00:00:00Z' or '2024-07-01T00:00:00+02:00').

dateBefore.description: Only include messages with timestamp strictly before this ISO 8601 datetime (e.g., '2024-07-31T23:59:59Z' or '2024-07-31T23:59:59+02:00').

direction.description: Pagination direction used with 'cursor': 'before' fetches older results, 'after' fetches newer results. Defaults to 'before' when only 'cursor' is provided.

excludeLowPriority.description: Exclude messages marked Low Priority by the user. Default: true. Set to false to include all.

includeMuted.description: Include messages in chats marked as Muted by the user, which are usually less important. Default: true. Set to false if the user wants a more refined search.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

mediaTypes.description: Filter messages by media types. Use ['any'] for any media type, or specify exact types like ['video', 'image']. Omit for no media filtering.

query.description: Literal word search (NOT semantic). Finds messages containing these EXACT words in any order. Use single words users actually type, not concepts or phrases. Example: use "dinner" not "dinner plans", use "sick" not "health issues". If omitted, returns results filtered only by other parameters.

anyOf.description: Filter by sender: 'me' (messages sent by the authenticated user), 'others' (messages sent by others), or a specific user ID string (user.id).

sender.description: Filter by sender: 'me' (messages sent by the authenticated user), 'others' (messages sent by others), or a specific user ID string (user.id).

tool.name: send_message
tool.description: Send a text message to a specific chat. Supports replying to existing messages. Returns the sent message ID and a deeplink to the chat

replyToMessageID.description: Provide a message ID to send this as a reply to an existing message

text.description: Text content of the message you want to send. You may use markdown.

tool.name: search_docs
tool.description:
Search for documentation for how to use the client to interact with the API.
The tool will return an array of Markdown-formatted documentation pages.

language.description: The language for the SDK to search for.
